body: I used to find these duo funny. Later, even without watching this movie, I decided that it was a bad movie and also not very funny.

First of all i enjoyed very much and that was really funny. Movie about being a bad time and bad place and two actors involved a homicide. Okey lets we talk about why the movie was so funny. First of all subject is really simple two musicians accidentally witness to homicide and this curse follow them all night. These are ordinary, simple, pure and poor musicians their act and conversations and dialogs totally real and funny. Everythings happens in a one night but long night and in the movie directors giving us flashback to link the missing parts and also this is a enjoyable part. I like the characters, scenario, background, and everything

It is selcuk aydemir's first movie ( actually first movie is kurbanlik but it haven't been relased because of the financial problems) and his best movie Calgi cengi's budget is very low only 20,000 us dollars and if cem yilmaz wouldn't support this movie we couldn't see this movie like kurbanlik and probably we couldn't see isler gucler,kardes payi,dugun dernek thanks to calgi cengi and cem yilmaz we could see selcuk's other great jobs however i don't like selcuk's new movies like ailecek saskiniz,baba parasi,calgi cengi ikimiz These days i think selcuk found money's recipe in turkish cinema and he using this formule every year and just grinding money i hope they grind money for further good jobs ( you know this films make good money and cemcir is producer of this films)

So i think this movie is milestone for selcuk,murat and ahmet
The budget of the movie was 30.000 TL and filmed in six days, from monday til saturday.
